primitives.name: Nut Burying Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: In the autumn, before the winter sets in, adult squirrels bury as many nuts as they can collect, separately, in the ground.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N': 'number of nuts buried (dimensionless)', 't': 'time of burial (seconds)', 'd': 'depth of burrow (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Adult squirrels exhibit deterministic, repeatable burrowing behavior under seasonal pressure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Behavioral collapse occurs when environmental cues are absent or altered.

layer2.mapping: Squirrel burrowing as a learned motor kernel with embedded temporal and spatial constraints; GSI models this as a Markovian sequence of sensory-motor actions.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency and consistency of burrow location reuse.

primitives.name: Burial Execution Routine
primitives.verbatim_quote: The whole process is executed with great rapidity, and, as it appeared to me, always with exactly the same movements ; in fact, it is done so well that I could never discover the traces of the burial-ground.
primitives.assumptions: Motor execution is invariant across individuals and time under stable conditions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure mode when external interference disrupts movement repetition.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a fixed-point attractor in dynamical systems; GSE maps this to a recurrent neural network with temporal memory.
layer2.telemetry: Repeatability of limb motion trajectories during burrowing.

primitives.name: Sensory Verification Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: Now, as regards the young squirrel, which, of course, never had been present at the burial of a nut, I observed that, after having eaten a number of hickory-nuts to appease its appetite, it would take one between its teeth, then sit upright and listen in all directions.
primitives.assumptions: Young squirrels perform risk-assessment before executing motor protocol.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cognitive failure when sensory thresholds fall below critical levels.

layer2.mapping: Risk-sensitivity loop modeled as a Bayesian decision tree; GSI evaluates this through conditional entropy of sensory states.
